Package: certifi (whl)
Version: 2026.7.22
Description: Python package for providing Mozilla's CA Bundle.

The inspected codebase consists of standard open-source Python libraries (Authlib, Cryptography, Requests, Urllib3, PyJWT, JoseRFC, CFFI, PyPinyin, Zhon, and Charset-Normalizer) alongside the WordBridge NVDA plugin for Chinese text typo correction via LLMs. No malicious payload delivery, unauthorized data exfiltration, or backdoors were detected.
